d:
Na jane kya huaa
Kal ek raja nind men chilla utha
Mantriyon! mujhe lokgathaon men jagah chahie
Chintit hue sare mantri
Adhikari hairan
Jiske pas pulis hai asankhy sena hai
Jaldurg, thaldurg jiske pas chaunsath kile hain
Us raja ko kya jarurat pari... aaj sahity tak par Poetry On Loop men sunie badri narayan ki kavita 'na jane kya huaa’.
